name: Career Compass Agent Skills
description: Public, anonymous career coaching instructions from the Sujeeth Foundation. Skills guide student-facing assistance; they are not a declaration of callable MCP tools.

skills.name: Resume and Application Review
skills.description: Review student-provided resumes and applications against job descriptions.

skills.name: Interview Preparation
skills.description: Practice interviews and prepare evidence-based behavioral responses.

skills.name: Career Exploration and Job Fit
skills.description: Explore careers, employers, and roles based on student goals.

skills.name: Networking and Informational Interviews
skills.description: Prepare outreach, informational conversations, and follow-up.

skills.name: Job Search Strategy
skills.description: Plan applications, follow-up, offers, and negotiation.
